# TIME

> TIME is a leading news and journalism platform covering breaking news, politics, world affairs, science, business, health, climate, entertainment, and sports with analysis and commentary.

TIME provides comprehensive coverage of current events across multiple verticals, from U.S. politics and international geopolitics to climate action and cultural trends. The site features both news reporting and opinion pieces from established journalists and thought leaders.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- U.S. Politics
- Geopolitics
- Climate Change
- Trump Administration
- Iran Conflict
- Sustainability
- Cybersecurity
- Economy
- Science
- Health & Wellness
- Entertainment
- Sports
- Renewable Energy
- World Affairs

## News & Breaking Updates

- [TIME | Current & Breaking News | National & World Updates](https://time.com): TIME homepage with breaking news on politics, world events, and current affairs
- [U.S. | TIME](https://time.com/section/us): TIME U.S. section with domestic news on politics, economy, crime, and national issues
- [World | TIME](https://time.com/section/world): TIME World section covering international news, geopolitics, and global affairs
- [Politics | TIME](https://time.com/section/politics): TIME Politics section covering White House, elections, Congress, and policy

## Science, Climate & Environment

- [Climate | TIME](https://time.com/section/climate): TIME Climate section with coverage of global warming and energy transition
- [Science | TIME](https://time.com/section/science): TIME Science section covering climate, space, biology, and scientific discoveries
- [The TIME Earth Awards | 2026](https://time.com/collection/earth-awards/2026): TIME Earth Awards honoring climate leaders including Stella McCartney and Jesper Brodin
- [Stella McCartney Made the Planet Fashionable—And She's Not Done Yet](https://time.com/collection/earth-awards/2026/stella-mccartney): Profile of fashion designer Stella McCartney's sustainable fashion innovation
- [Jesper Brodin: Sustainability Is a Smart Investment](https://time.com/collection/earth-awards/2026/jesper-brodin): Interview with Ikea CEO Jesper Brodin on sustainability and corporate leadership
- [Hindou Oumarou Ibrahim Asks What Happens If Everything Goes Right for the Planet](https://time.com/collection/earth-awards/2026/hindou-oumarou-ibrahim): Essay by Indigenous climate leader Hindou Oumarou Ibrahim on environmental justice

## Business, Health & Economy

- [Business | TIME](https://time.com/section/business): TIME Business section with news on economy, markets, CEOs, and corporate trends
- [Health | TIME](https://time.com/section/health): TIME Health section covering medicine, wellness, vaccines, and health policy

## Ideas & Opinion

- [Ideas | TIME](https://time.com/section/ideas): TIME Ideas section featuring opinion and commentary on news, society, culture
- [How Profits Took Over American Politics | TIME](https://time.com/7383185/profits-took-over-american-politics): Opinion piece on money in politics and Trump administration profit concerns
- [Why Cybersecurity Threats Are Growing | TIME](https://time.com/7382979/cybersecurity-threats-are-growing): Analysis of AI-driven cybersecurity threats and emerging attack methods
- [Without Science, America's Prosperity Is At Risk | TIME](https://time.com/7382995/science-scientific-method-us): Essay on importance of scientific method for U.S. economic and technological leadership

## Entertainment & Culture

- [Entertainment | TIME](https://time.com/section/entertainment): TIME Entertainment section covering movies, TV, music, and pop culture
- [Ballet Isn't Dead, But Timothée Chalamet Might Have a Point | TIME](https://time.com/7383265/timothee-chalamet-ballet-opera): Cultural commentary on ballet's challenges following Timothée Chalamet remarks

## Sports

- [Sports | TIME](https://time.com/section/sports): TIME Sports section with coverage of Olympics, World Cup, and major athletics
